Dtech DT-5002A USB to Serial RS232 Converter cable

The Dtech DT-5002A USB to Serial RS232 Converter Cable is a practical solution for connecting devices with RS232 serial ports to modern computers via USB. This adapter is ideal for applications like industrial equipment, barcode scanners, and legacy systems that require serial communication.

Key Features

  • Connector Type: DB9 male to USB Type-A male
  • Data Transfer Rate: Up to 1 Mbps
  • Cable Length: 1.2 meters
  • USB Compliance: USB 2.0
  • Compatibility: Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux
  • Plug-and-Play: No external power required
  • Applications: Ideal for connecting PDAs, modems, and serial peripherals​
